name: Albescent-Bajada
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in bioluminescent seas. Travelers navigate by massive canyon systems and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.

Breathable air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything. Herds of six-limbed graziers shadow the meltwater margins, wary of anything that walks upright.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
